name: Hetal Jhaveri
bio: Hetal Jhaveri is a faculty at Amrut Mody School of Management with over 26 years of industry and academic experience. She has done her doctoral research in Retail Banking Innovations. She attended the Executive Programme at the Judge Business School, University of Cambridge, UK. Her Post Graduation is in commerce with a specialization in Management. She holds a Diploma in Business Finance from ICFAI. She has more than 6 years of corporate experience in project finance, equity research and leasing & Hires purchase. She is a full-time academician for more than 20 years. She has been a faculty at various Management Development Programmes and Executive Programmes. She teaches courses in Financial Management, Financial Markets and Institutions, Corporate Restructuring, Bank Management, and Venture Capital & Private Equity at M.B.A. and Banking at the undergraduate programmes. She is also guiding and mentoring candidates at the postgraduate and doctoral level programmes.
